Name: CoStar Group Inc
Description: CoStar Group, Inc. is a leading provider of proprietary online information, analytics, and services tailored to the commercial real estate sector and its related industries, including hospitality and residential markets, across the globe. With a robust presence in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Latin America, the company excels in delivering insights that empower real estate professionals to make informed decisions. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., CoStar Group leverages advanced technology and data-driven solutions to enhance market transparency and facilitate efficient transactions in real estate markets worldwide.
